svg.title: 38. Child pose with arms relaxed — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Kneel with your feet close together. Move your buttocks towards your heels and lower your chest. Rest your forehead on a cushion and place your arms beside your legs.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Childs_Pose.json
